title: Coconut Doraji Stir Fry
description: A Thai-inspired stir fry dish featuring doraji and bellflower, served with a side of nostalgic crispy fried noodles.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of aerated oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced irish onion and cook until softened.
Add the sliced doraji and bellflower, and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Add the diced root vegetable and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and stir well.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the confit and cook for 1 minute.
Serve hot with a side of crispy fried noodles.
